title: F40 remainder: a prompt-regression replay proves triage drops cycle 1691's stale item
summary: F40 landed the deterministic premise_drift section for fleet-lane triage, triage persona Step 0b (re-verify a drifted premise at HEAD; drop a stale one with reason stale: <evidence>) and production-reachability requirements in the fault-localization and bug-reproduction personas; F30 turns such a drop into planned no-work plus a console hand-off. What is NOT pinned is the judgment itself: that a triage given 1691's real input (the item, its drift, base 3c096262) drops it as stale citing acssuite.ReadVerdict. Record: docs/incidents/2026-09-26-stale-premise-reached-build.md.
root_cause: The pipeline trusts an item's premise from filing time. premise-challenge exists and its goal-is-wrong attack names 'the bug is already fixed' (agents/evolve-premise-challenge.md), but it is inserted only when scout.cycle_size == large, its categories are [feature], and its verdict is verdict_from_sentinel=shadow (.evolve/phases/premise-challenge/phase.json) — so it never ran on 1691 and would not have gated if it had. fault-localization and bug-reproduction take 'the exact scenario described in the issue' on trust (agents/evolve-fault-localization.md, agents/evolve-bug-reproduction.md): neither asks whether a PRODUCTION writer and entry path can deliver the triggering state to the defect site, so a fixture that constructs an unreachable state passes as a reproduction.
fix: Add a prompt-regression replay (the prompt-regression-eval machinery or an ACS eval) that runs the triage persona on cycle 1691's recorded input and asserts a stale drop that cites the upstream gate; keep it out of the per-cycle hot path.
acceptance: A replay of cycle 1691's triage input (item + premise_drift + base 3c096262) yields dropped[] with a stale: reason citing acssuite/evidence.go ReadVerdict — pinned as a prompt-regression eval
The eval runs outside the per-cycle hot path (scheduled or on persona change)
connects_to: triage-termination-scope-aware (F30: the no-work terminal a stale-premise lane ends on)
go/internal/acssuite/evidence.go (#535 ReadVerdict — the upstream gate the reproduction bypassed)
Observed in passing: .evolve/phases/bug-reproduction/agent.md duplicates agents/evolve-bug-reproduction.md with drifted text — personas load from agents/; retire the copy (single source).

Observed in passing: inboxbatch.Classify / the wave planner count an item with a pending console-owned dep (artifact-bytes-signal-dual-rendering → egps-regression-tia-selection) as dispatchable while the launcher's freshness probe refuses it (loopwave/launcher.go:74-80) — one dispatchability belief should include deps.
